description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the ReviewEmployeeSupervisorAPI, testing various API endpoints related to employee supervision reviews within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It includes test cases for retrieving all reviews, and placeholder tests for create, delete, get, and update operations which are expected to throw 'not implemented' exceptions.
